ideas.pitch: A real-time predictive analytics engine designed to forecast sudden infrastructure failures, LLM hallucinations, and cascading system outages using Poisson GAMs and rolling backtests.
ideas.title: Singularity-Audit: Autonomous AI Incident Forecasting Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies the hard engineering patterns of rigorous probabilistic modeling seen in the Apart Research win, matching the cosmic singularity theme of structural failures.

ideas.pitch: An automated anti-money laundering risk investigation platform that combines graph intelligence and Focal LightGBM to trace suspicious wallet transactions and flag high-risk liquidity pools.
ideas.title: GraphGuard: AWS-Powered AML Risk Detection for DeFi
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the complex architecture and graph analytics of the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon winner, offering judges a production-ready financial compliance tool.

ideas.pitch: A no-code platform for building, copying, and executing automated trading strategies on perpetual DEXs with built-in escrow settlement.
ideas.title: PerpAgent: Autonomous AI Trading Bot Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven winning formula of combining automated AI agents with decentralized execution marketplaces seen in the Synthesis Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite imagery analysis platform that automatically detects unauthorized industrial expansion, environmental degradation, and zoning violations.
ideas.title: GeoSentinel: Satellite Monitoring for Industrial Land Compliance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Presents heavy computer vision and real-world geospatial utility just like the Xcelerate Hackathon runner-up, which stands out strongly in a short sprint.

ideas.pitch: A localized multi-agent healthcare platform that automates patient intake, trust-building consultations, and personalized treatment planning for specialized clinics.
ideas.title: BioTrust: AI-Powered Patient Trust & Acquisition Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the rapid-fire utility and polished user acquisition workflows of the Elevate X prize-winning project built within a tight 12-to-18 hour window.
